policy.score_rule: Rubric anchors determine proposed scores; quota labels never lower or raise gold scores.
policy.text_rule: When a target response profile was inconsistent with rubric-correct scoring, the response text was rewritten instead of forcing the score.
policy.speaking_rule: Synthetic delivery observations are generation aids only and must not become gold. Real audio or teacher observation is required before delivery scoring.
policy.human_gate: This recalibration is AI-generated and is not an independent teacher review. No candidate may enter dataset/records or become teacher_verified until human review.
